hints.title: Count Available Steps
hints.text: The path requires destination[1] Horizontal steps and destination[0] Vertical steps.

hints.title: Count Paths Choosing H
hints.text: Choosing H leaves comb(h - 1 + v, h - 1) possible remaining paths.

hints.title: Compare with k
hints.text: If k is at most the path count, pick H; otherwise pick V, subtract that path count from k, and continue.

hints.title: Full Implementation
